limitations: audio-only still uses a frozen acoustic encoder which may represent onsets; only explicit soft-onset channel is ablated
shared architecture and identical full initial state; both trained from scratch for 10 epochs
new transformations of three seen songs are shift diagnostics, not independent-song tests
conditional subframe MAE assumes the correct frame and is not whole-onset accuracy
note-type/context-pattern quality is deferred by user; described but not a timing gate
failed/incomplete generations stay failures in benchmark; any partial F1 is diagnostic only
compared with old DT baselines, representation, losses and data recipe also differ
fairness_checks: identical initialization, architecture, training sources, sample manifests, seed, budget; variant is the explicit input switch
